_what: The Content-Security-Policy the engine sends on every workspace HTML page (src/workspace.rs page_policy). Each directive lists its sources: a CSP keyword (written quoted), the response's own nonce (fresh per response; the engine puts it on the import map and on every inline script the page document writes), or the engine's own loopback address in a named scheme (the Host the session owner admitted, so a page's socket and reads may reach its own door). Sandboxed saved screens add their own meta policy inside their frame; this one does not replace it.
